name: إيتوكاوا
fact: First asteroid sample ever returned to Earth — JAXA's Hayabusa survived a hydrazine leak, three dead reaction wheels, an ion engine failure, and a seven-week communications blackout to bring 1500 micrograms of Itokawa material to Woomera AUS on 2010-06-13.
bio: Peanut-shaped 540 × 270 × 210-m near-Earth asteroid discovered 1998. The 2005 Hayabusa rendezvous revealed Itokawa as a gravitationally-bound rubble pile rather than a solid body — a collection of fragments held together by mutual gravity, with the boulder distribution and absence of impact craters indicating regolith reset events on a geologically active small body.
